offering_description.value: Designs, builds and sells single-family homes through its builder subsidiaries, mainly to individual homebuyers. It also acquires and develops residential land for its own use and for sale to others, and offers affiliated mortgage, title and home-related services.

primary_services.value: residential land development; mortgage financing; title services

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual homebuyers, including entry-level, move-up and luxury buyers; B2B: third-party homebuilders buying finished lots

revenue_model.value: product sales: sales of newly built homes and developed lots; service fees: mortgage origination and title and closing services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds homes using purchased land and subcontracted labor and materials, sold to homebuyers; service provider: develops land into lots, offers mortgage and title services to buyers

geography_served.value: US regional: Texas (Dallas-Fort Worth, Houston, Austin) and Georgia (Atlanta), plus Florida and other Sunbelt markets

specialization.value: related lines: homebuilding, land development, mortgage and title services sharing the same homebuyers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales staff at model homes and communities; agents / brokers: third-party real estate agents bringing buyers; online: builder brand websites for lead generation

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: building codes, zoning, land use and environmental rules, mortgage lending rules such as RESPA and CFPB
